title: Supersymmetric Yang--Mills theories with several times reduce to ten dimensions
summary: Supersymmetric Yang--Mills theories in signatures with several times are built by restricting the gaugino to the kernel of $k$ mutually orthogonal null vectors and letting the supersymmetry close on translations contracted with their product. We prove that every theory of this kind, defined by five axioms that Nishino's construction satisfies, has residual dimension $s+t-2k$ equal to ten (or to two, a degenerate case), and that its null vectors can be real only if $k\le\min(s,t)$.
